findings.current: The shields, made from dried wood covered with the hide of old horses, did an excellent job of stopping the arrows.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the shields were specifically faced with hide from an old horse’s rump.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly identifies both the extreme dryness of the wood and the particular part of the horse used to reinforce it.
findings.replacement: The shields, made of bone-dry wood faced with hide from an old horse’s rump, did an excellent job of stopping the arrows.
findings.source: 바짝 마른 나무에 늙은 말의 엉덩이 가죽을 덧대어 만든 방패는 훌륭히 화살들을 막아 냈다.

findings.current: Those who had already climbed over the walls were stabbed and cut by weapons surging in from every direction.
findings.defect: “Climbed over the walls” places the attackers beyond the wall and inside the compound, whereas the source only says they had already climbed up; the surrounding scene locates the melee atop the walls.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the attackers’ position on the wall instead of implying that they successfully crossed it.
findings.replacement: Those who had already reached the top were stabbed and slashed by weapons converging from every direction.
findings.source: 이미 올라간 자들은 사방에서 짓쳐 들어오는 병장기에 찔리고 베였다.

findings.current: The mounted bandit dropped to his knees in front of Pung Yang and continued in a breathless voice.
findings.defect: The draft changes a full, immediate prostration into merely dropping to one’s knees, weakening both the physical action and the subordinate’s terrified deference.
findings.rationale: 넙죽 엎드려 means prostrating oneself flat, not simply kneeling.
findings.replacement: The moment he reached Pung Yang, the mounted bandit threw himself flat on the ground and continued in a breathless voice.
findings.source: 마적은 그의 앞에 섬과 동시에 넙죽 엎드려 헐떡거리는 목소리로 말을 이었다.

findings.current: Inside was something that could bring down a tiger in a single stroke.
findings.defect: “In a single stroke” adds a striking or cutting mechanism that the source does not specify, prematurely characterizing the still-unrevealed object.
findings.rationale: 단숨에 conveys doing it at once or in one go, without specifying that the object must be used for a stroke.
findings.replacement: Inside was something that could bring down a tiger in one go.
findings.source: 그 안에 호랑이를 단숨에 거꾸러트릴 물건이 들어 있었다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it alters one combat position, weakens a deferential physical action, omits a specific shield material detail, and adds an unsupported attack mechanism to the final reveal.
